items.title: SSI New Material (Zhenjiang) Co., Ltd. (03707)
items.en_oneliner: New materials company SSI New Material is taking subscriptions from 27 November to 2 December, with an offer price of HK$6.00 to HK$7.00, and lists on 7 December. Oversubscribed about 4.64 times.
